answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy depends on making influence cost more than presence. A whisper of self-assertion earns nothing; only answers that independent peers grade and attest build standing, and each epoch charges every key the same renewal price regardless of how many copies exist. Honest work spreads across a meadow slowly, root by root, while a flood of clones arrives like an ocean tide with no soil to hold it. The asymmetry is the defense: genuine contribution compounds, manufactured identity evaporates.
